what: Spoken lines for Community Builders of Pecan Grove (English and Spanish), the exact on-screen words of each line.
made_with: ElevenLabs Text to Speech (web app), model Eleven v4; voices from the ElevenLabs Voice Library
made_by: Generated by A2 Learning Studio, 11 Oct 2026; encoded with ffmpeg (mono, 64 kbps, loudness -18 LUFS).
word_timing: Estimated from the pauses in each clip and the syllables of each word (tools/make_voice_assets.py); used for the read-along highlight.

cast.note: The eight character clips (nb-ana, English and Spanish) were re-encoded on 2026-10-20 with a high-pass, de-esser, limiter and loudnorm (-18 LUFS, true peak -2 dB) at 96 kbps, 44100 Hz mono, after playtesters heard harshness. The spoken words were not regenerated.

added_2026_10_24: 12 lines that had no voice (Stops 1, 2, 8, 10 and 12, Mrs. Ana's three Stop 12 answers, and the two-team prompts) were generated through the ElevenLabs API with Eleven v4 in the same cast voices, encoded like the rest; Mrs. Ana's three with the 20 Oct softer treatment at 96 kbps.
